visual_action: A slideshow of still photographs. The first photo shows Kamala Harris standing alone in a garden setting. The second shows Harris and Joe Biden walking together and laughing in the same garden. The third photo shows Harris being sworn in at an inauguration ceremony, with her hand raised while a man, Doug Emhoff, holds a Bible for her in front of the U.S. Capitol building.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Kamala Harris appears in every photo in the slideshow and is named in the on-screen text.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: Joe Biden appears in a photo with Kamala Harris and is named in the on-screen text as the one who selected her as his running mate.

cast.name: Doug Emhoff
cast.evidence: Doug Emhoff is shown holding the Bible during Kamala Harris's swearing-in ceremony.

on_screen_text.text: Joe Biden asked Kamala Harris to be his running mate.

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue; the video is set to music.
audio_music: A continuous, inspirational, and slightly nostalgic instrumental track plays throughout the video, creating a momentous and celebratory tone.
editing_pacing: The video is a slow-paced slideshow of still photographs, with each photo displayed for a few seconds.
central_claim: The video commemorates the historic three-year anniversary of Joe Biden selecting Kamala Harris as his vice-presidential running mate.
intended_effect: To evoke feelings of pride and inspiration by highlighting a key historical moment for the Biden-Harris administration.
